cols.name: Overall
cols.desc: Tanking (AC, HP, damage taken, damage dealt)

a.text: Can plant two auras at once, carrying both traits. Unlocks Pyrrhic Parade (50 TL): ◄ allies' crits spill over, dealing the same damage to a second creature within the aura; Enemies ► enemies' crits against allies become normal hits; trait: Dylan can't score crits.

b.text: Once per long rest: all HP that Dylan and his allies paid to his Betrayal abilities this combat is dealt as true damage, split among enemies in his flag's radius.

nodes.text: +1 AC per rank.
+15 max HP per rank.
Destructive Aftershock +2 per rank.
Unyielding grants +10 temp HP per rank.
Fervid Vengeance bonus +1 per rank at every threshold.
R1: once per round, when a single hit deals 20% of max HP damage, regain 1 battle die. R2: the threshold drops to 10%.
Advantage on saves against being knocked prone or forcibly moved.
Bloodthirsty Resolve recharges on a short rest.

R1: unlocks the aura (15 TL). ◄ Allies may Disengage as a free action and ignore the first opportunity attack against them each round. Enemies ► the first time an enemy tries to leave the aura each turn, it is tethered (STR save ends) and Dylan regains 1 battle die. Trait: Dylan's speed is halved. R2: DC increases by PB. R3: Allies ignore the first two opportunity attacks.

R1: unlocks the aura (30 TL). ◄ When an enemy in the aura dies, every ally regains 1 reaction. Enemies ► when an ally in the aura dies, every enemy loses 1 reaction until the end of its next turn. Trait: Dylan cannot take reactions. R2: When an enemy in the aura dies, allies also gain +PB on their next attack. R3: Enemies who lose a reaction also have disadvantage on Dodge, Block and Parry until the end of their next turn.

R1: unlocks the aura (30 TL). ◄ Allies are immune to Frightened and have advantage on saves against forced movement. Enemies ► enemies save against Frightened (Dylan's DC) at the start of each of their turns; Frightened enemies have their speed halved. Trait: Dylan has disadvantage on attacks against any creature that isn't Frightened. R2: Bravery's Throne: creatures that aren't Frightened lose Dylan's PB on attack rolls not made against him. R3: Frightened enemies in the aura take Dylan's PB in psychic damage at the start of their turns, and the aura costs 10 TL less.

R1: unlocks the aura (45 TL). ◄ Damage that would drop an ally to 0 HP leaves them at 1 instead; the excess goes to Dylan. Enemies ► enemies cannot be healed or gain temp HP. Trait: Dylan gains no benefit from resistances or temp HP. R2: aura radius 20 → 30 ft.
Dylan takes 10% of max HP as true damage and regains 1 battle die and 10 TL. Per extra rank: +5 TL.
A willing ally within 10 ft loses 10% of its max HP. Dylan gains that much temp HP. R2: works on two allies at once. R3: the sacrificed health rises to 20%.
I Can Do Better deals +1d6 psychic per rank on top of its +2d6. R3: it skips its cooldown if Dylan hurt himself or an ally with a Betrayal ability this round.

Each time Dylan or an ally loses 10% HP from a Betrayal ability, Dylan gains +1 Treachery. His next attack gains +10% damage per Treachery (max 5). That attack spends all his Treachery. R2: max Treachery 7.

cols.name: Overall
cols.desc: Range, effectiveness and duration of melodies

a.text: Once per long rest while Wasted: for 3 rounds every hymn plays at double effect and a failed Wasted save can't end her Melody.

b.text: While Mind Link holds 3+ creatures, each hymn also deals Melody Factor psychic damage to one enemy in range (once per turn).

nodes.text: Melody range +5 ft per rank (30 → 45 ft).
+5 max MP per rank.
Melody Factor +4 per rank.
Per rank, choose one hymn: it costs 1 MP less (min 1).
Sweet Melody heals +5% of max HP per rank.
A Masterful Performer pairing lasts +1 round per rank.
An extra hymn in the same turn costs +3 → +2 → +1 MP.
Switching Melodies costs no action, and the new Melody starts free once per combat.

R1: once per turn, when she plays a hymn, she can drink as part of it without using her bonus action. She enters Wasted after drinking more than four times instead of three. R2: she enters Wasted after drinking more than five times (Wasted on the 6th drink), and each drink gives +8 MP instead of +5. R3: at the start of each combat, if her tally is below 2, it becomes 2. Two drinks in one round: the MP stacks, but the CHA doubling and the extra free hymn don't.
While she's Dizzy, allies gain +2 to attack rolls. R2: While she's Dizzy, allies' crit range expands by 1. R3: allies gain +10 Morale at the start of their turn.

While Dizzy, each creature within 15 ft makes a CON save or becomes Dizzy (Tier I). Her drink tally resets to 0. R2: radius increases to 20 ft. R3: Dizzy creatures make a CON save or become Nauseous; the next attack against a Nauseous creature deals Melody Factor damage.
When she would become Nauseous, drink instead: no Nauseous, +10 MP, and she stays Dizzy. R2: +15 MP.
3 MP. Link allies telepathically for 1 minute: they can communicate in their heads and share sight (ends if Sika is incapacitated). 2 allies, +1 per rank.
5 MP. When a creature within 60 ft attacks: WIS save or it has disadvantage and the damage is reduced by 10%. The reduction increases by 5% per rank.
10 MP. Choose a creature within 20 ft: WIS save or it loses 5 MP, TL or Ki; Sika gains that much MP. R2: it loses 10. R3: it loses 15, and the loss comes off its max.

R1: once per round, when a linked creature would drop a Morale tier, Sika can spend 5 MP to hold it: its Morale stops at the bottom of its current tier instead. R2: linked creatures can lose at most 20 Morale per round from other creatures' effects (the Swing Cap is normally 30).

a.text: Once per long rest: every enemy within 30 ft makes a STR save or is Launched. She then makes one fan strike against each airborne creature (each counts as a juggle hit), and they land Prone.

b.text: Once per long rest, she can combine two school-changing modifications on one spell, breaking the usual special rule.

nodes.text: Twin Gales thrown range +10 ft per rank.
Twin Gales damage +2 per rank.
+1 per rank to her Persuasion roll for Flirtatious.
+2 to concentration saves per rank.
+2 initiative per rank.
R1: Ride the Winds doesn't provoke. R2: Ride the Winds +15 ft.
A creature with a fan swirling around it takes 1 fan weapon die slashing per fan at the start of its turn.
Spells she casts through the Twin Gales can originate from a swirling fan as if she stood there. Range and area are measured from the fan.

R1: when a creature within 15 ft hits her with a melee attack, she flicks a fan beneath it: STR save (her spell DC) or it is Launched. The fan returns to her hand. R2: the fan rises with it: she makes a free fan strike against it midair (it counts as a juggle hit). R3: range 30 ft, and it also triggers on ranged attacks.

R1: replaces one attack: she rides the wind up to 20 ft in a straight line (no opportunity attacks) and strikes the first creature with both fans. It counts as a Launcher, so the hit launches if it beats the threshold. R2: 30 ft, and it deals +1 weapon die against airborne targets. R3: after the hit, she can carry on to a second creature within 10 ft and strike it too.

R1: with both fans in hand, she sends them spiralling around her: each creature within 15 ft makes a DEX save or takes 4d8 slashing and is pushed 10 ft backwards. The fans return. R2: airborne creatures caught in it stay airborne and it deals +1 weapon die (it counts as a juggle hit on each). R3: radius increases to 25 ft and crit range against airborne creatures expands by 1.

R1: creatures she launched can be juggled for up to 5 hits instead of 3. R2: her Critical Air Takedown also applies Deafening Winds. R3: once per turn she can Ride the Winds up to a launched creature for free and attack it from above.

Each rank unlocks a modification. R1 Amplify (20 TL): the spell's damage or healing dice go up one size (d6 → d8 → d10 → d12). R2 Saturate (25 TL): area +10 ft radius, or double a line's length. R3 Ascendant (40 TL): the spell is cast as if from a slot one level higher.

R1 Fusion (25 TL): half the spell's damage becomes a second type of her choice. Each half checks the target's resistances separately. R2 Resonance (20 TL): if the target is vulnerable to either type, all of the spell's damage counts as that type. R3 Catalyst (30 TL): fused damage can trigger combination statuses (e.g. Fire + Necrotic = Hellfire).

R1 Temper (25 TL): the spell's damage becomes physical (bludgeoning, piercing or slashing): magic resistance, anti-magic and counterspells don't affect it, but Block and ADR do. R2 Spell-Edge (20 TL): a Tempered spell delivered through Spellstrike counts as a weapon hit for on-hit effects, and counts as a Launcher. R3 Veiled Casting (20 TL): no verbal or somatic components; it can't be Read or interrupted until it lands.

R1 Reshape (15 TL): change the spell's area shape (sphere, cone, line or cube), keeping its size. R2 Sustain (35 TL): a concentration spell doesn't need concentration for 2 rounds (one at a time). R3: modifications that don't change school cost 5 TL less (min 10).

a.text: As an action, once per long rest, she merges three Elder vines with different jobs within 30 ft of each other into one Paragon vine. It has their combined HP and Verdant and Elder stats, reach 20 ft, and every merged job's Elder ability. It takes one action per job each turn. Each job adds a fusion trait: Harvester: the Sap it makes can go straight into Degree. Shooter: its thorns carry its other jobs (an Alchemy creation coats them; Spike seeds a 5 ft root patch where they hit). Spike: its root field is centred on it permanently, and its jobs have advantage against creatures in the roots. Alchemy: once a round, spraying costs no action. Degree: each Sap she spends on it gives +1 (max 10). Degree 5: +1 action each turn. Degree 10: Grove's Wrath (once): every job fires at full effect at once. Lasts until it drops to 0 HP or she finishes a long rest.

b.text: Once per long rest, for 3 rounds, all four seasons trigger on every strike.

nodes.text: Adds to her Alchemy Bag's Starting Stock. R1: +1 common Poisonous, +1 uncommon Poisonous, +2 uncommon Curative. R2: +2 uncommon Reactive, +1 uncommon Poisonous. R3: +2 rare Reactive, +1 rare Poisonous, +2 rare Curative.
Alchemical creations deal or heal +2 per rank.
Blooming Vine max HP +10 per rank.
Precision chance +2% per rank (double crit damage).
R1: Rapid Growth range +5 ft. R2: Rapid Growth plants +1 seed (stacks with Blooming Forest). R3: once per combat, Rapid Growth is a free action.
R1: +1 Rapid Growth use. R2: Rapid Growth uses reset after a short rest.
In combat, she can craft a creation of Rare or lower as a bonus action (normally Common or Uncommon, as an action).
Once per long rest, halve (rounded down) each ingredient cost to brew a potion or poison.
R1: unlocks Harvester Verdant*. R2: unlocks Harvester Elder*. R3 Bumper Crop: Harvest the Field rolls once more for each Harvester that ended the combat Verdant or Elder.
R1: unlocks Shooter Verdant*. R2: unlocks Shooter Elder*. R3 Splitting Thorns: each thorn that hits splits to a second creature within 10 ft for half damage, and Thorn Launch range becomes 90/270.
R1: unlocks the Spike job (Sprout: Root Bed). R2: unlocks Spike Verdant*: Thorn Field. R3: unlocks Spike Elder*: Impaling Ground.
R1: unlocks the Alchemy job (Sprout: Bulb). R2: unlocks Alchemy Verdant*: Twin Bulb. R3: unlocks Alchemy Elder*: Distillery.

R1: unlocks Summer. When switching to the Bow, until the end of her turn each arrow's crit range expands by 1 per flower on its target (max 3: crits on 17–20). R2: unlocks Winter. When switching to the Blades, her next strike freezes the target: its speed drops to 0 and it has disadvantage on its next attack. R3 Full Bloom: when she switches, she gets both seasons of that form: Bow = Spring + Summer (bloom, then crit off the new flowers), Blades = Autumn + Winter (wither and freeze on the same strike).

R1: the Bow fires five arrows instead of three. R2: when a coated arrow kills a creature, the coating isn't used up: it also covers her next turn (once per turn). R3: crits trigger it too (up to 3 times per turn, each adding one more turn of coating).

R1: the Blades' double-hit temp HP rises to 30% of the target's max HP. R2: when she kills a creature with the Blades, she gains 1 common reagent (once per turn). R3: crits trigger it too (up to 3 times per turn).

R1: once per turn, she may switch forms again for free, applying the season. R2: creatures can carry up to 5 flowers, and Autumn's wither damage becomes 1d10 per flower (Summer still counts at most 3). R3: her first strike after a switch also applies the season(s) of the form she just left.

yohan-tree.name: Yohan — The Diamond in the Rough

a.text: Once per long rest, for 3 rounds: Momentum Dice never expire, Buried Momentum costs nothing, his Dune stacks never reset, and there's no limit on how many MD he generates a round. When it starts, he gains Momentum Dice up to his cap.

b.text: Once per long rest, for 3 rounds he holds all four stances at once, and each halberd attack counts as both Hack and Pierce.

nodes.text: +5 ft speed per rank.
+2 focus points per rank.
Halberd damage +2 per rank.
Each Momentum Die spent deals +1 damage per rank.
+2 initiative per rank.
A short rest returns +3 focus per rank.
When he crits a creature, each creature within 10 ft of it also loses 10 Morale.
The first Dragon Surge after each rest doesn't raise its cost.
R1: he can generate up to 4 MD a round instead of 3. R2: Momentum Dice become d10s. R3: his Momentum Dice cap rises from PB to PB + 2, and Rising Dawn no longer halves his movement.

R1 Long Road: one turn of up to 45 degrees per turn doesn't break his line. R2 Carried Wind: if he ends his turn having moved in a straight line, his Dune stacks carry into his next turn instead of resetting (still resets if he is hit, grappled, or knocked prone). R3 Desert Wrath: his Dune stack cap rises from 6 to 9. At 9 stacks he can spend them all to take an extra turn right after this one ( once per long rest).

R1 Dune Shelter: while in Buried Momentum, he loses 1 Momentum Die per 10 ft moved instead of per 5 ft. R2: creatures that fail his Dunewall Charge save are also Blinded until the end of their next turn. R3: he can change direction once during the charge.

R1 Overspend: when he uses Dunebreaker Strike, half of the Momentum Dice he spent (rounded down) stay with him. He can spend them on a second Dunebreaker against a different creature this turn, or on anything else that costs MD. R2: if Dunebreaker lands on the same attack as his Momentum Finisher, its Momentum Dice deal double. R3 Monolith: a Dunebreaker or Finisher hit forces a CON save, or the target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

R1 Crescent Sweep (Attack, 1 focus): Hack; one swing hits every creature in a 10 ft arc in front of him. R2 Hook & Pull (Attack, 1 focus): on a Hack hit, he hooks the target with the axe head: pull it 10 ft toward him, or knock it Prone. R3 Skewer (1 focus): on a Pierce hit, the target is pinned on the spear point. It can't move away from him until it succeeds on a STR save (its action), and his attacks against it get +2 while it's pinned.
R1: entering a stance becomes a free action (once per turn). R2: keeping the same stance on his next turn costs 1 Ki instead of 3. R3: he can hold two stances at once (paying for both).

R1 Crimson Cleave (Red Dunes): his Bleed deals +PB damage, and a creature already Bleeding takes its bleed damage again when he hits it with Hack. R2 Sirocco Lance (Sirocco): after moving 10+ ft, his attacks ignore half cover, and the target's Dodge has disadvantage. R3 Scorpion Tail (Scorpion): his opportunity attacks can Pierce at 15 ft reach, and a hit drops the target's speed to 0.

R1: while in Buried Tomb, Falcon Wing Deflection costs 1 focus, and he can use it for an ally within his reach. R2: while in Buried Tomb, creatures that end their turn within his reach take Hack damage (no roll). R3: while in Buried Tomb, allies within his reach can't be pushed, pulled or knocked prone, and gain +2 AC.

a.text: Once per long rest, place a seal of every type on one creature at once. They tick separately, don't count against her cap, and advance together: when one gains a tier, they all do.

b.text: Once per long rest, for 3 rounds the first attack against her each round automatically misses, counting as a successful dodge.

nodes.text: +1 to Dodge checks per rank.
+5 ft speed per rank.
+2 Ki per rank.
+2 initiative per rank.
Her Maneuver save DC +1 per rank (a failed save she forces also ticks the creature's seal through Eye of the Storm).
Still Water can be used +1 time per round per rank.
Her movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks from creatures she dodged this round.
Uncanny Metabolism also fills her Flow.

R1: once per round, placing a seal on a hit doesn't cost her reaction. R2: she can seal herself as a free action (normally a bonus action) and a willing ally within 5 ft as a bonus action. R3: she can keep +1 seal on the field (PB → PB + 1).

R1: seals advance a tier every 2 ticks instead of 3 (Tier 6 at 10 ticks). R2 Resonance: when a seal advances a tier, one seal within 10 ft gains +1 tick. R3 Deep Drain: her seals drain more per tick: 2 × PB Ki, or (WIS × PB) + PB TL or HP.

Bonus action: break one of her seals to unleash it, scaled by its tier. Each rank unlocks a school. R1 Demonic: the target takes WIS × PB necrotic per tier and has Collapse until the end of its next turn. R2 Angelic: the target and allies within 15 ft regain WIS × PB HP per tier. R3 Draconic: for 1 round the target gains the effect of the next tier up, and any Draconic Growth left on the seal converts to ticks on another of her seals.
New seals start at Tier 2. R2: Tier 3. (A head start counts as that tier's ticks, so with Quickened Seal a Tier 3 start is 4 ticks.)

On a successful dodge, spend 1 Flow to make an unarmed strike against the attacker. R2: on a hit, she can spend 2 Flow to make the target act last in the order next round. R3: the counter strike deals +1 Martial Arts die and pushes the target 10 ft.
Flow max +1 per rank (PB → PB + 2). R2: she also starts each combat with 2 Flow. R3: when she reaches max Flow, she gains 1 Tempo (once per round).

R1 Seize the Initiative (2 Flow): at the start of a round, move her turn to the top of the order for this round. R2 Half-Beat (2 Flow): end her turn early and keep what she hasn't used; take the rest at the end of any creature's turn later this round. R3 Call the Tempo (2 Flow, bonus action): one ally who hasn't gone yet moves to right after her this round.
When she has at least 3 Flow, Flurry of Blows makes +1 strike per rank.
